canonical_data: agent profiles, conversations, dialog logs and conversation state in a file repository by default or MongoDB through a plugin, with knowledge collections in a vector database such as Qdrant
current_repo_note: The admin interface the quick start points to lives in a separate repository, BotSharp-UI, and is not part of this record.
strengths: A routing agent runs an instruction loop that picks the next task agent, saves conversation state, appends every dialog to a store and emits hooks, so handoff between agents is code with persisted state rather than a prompt convention
Nearly everything is a plugin behind an abstraction: dozens of model, storage, channel and tool plugins, MCP tool execution, and an agent testing and evaluation hook set
Apache-2.0 across a single licence file, with a file-based default store that needs no database to start
weaknesses: The readme still advertises model versions from 2024 and 2025 and a roadmap in which browser and computer use are unchecked, so its capability list lags the plugin directory
The admin interface is a separate repository, so a running system needs two projects and the quick start sends the reader out of this one
Agent behaviour depends on the prompts and planner each application defines, and no cross-application task success figures are published
why_it_matters: A long-lived, permissively licensed .NET option for teams that want agent routing, planning and conversation state inside an existing enterprise stack rather than in a Python framework.
